Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 145. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 35
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Instant Kamehameha
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (125 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
An almost planet shattering kamehameha.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 40 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw dealing 8d8 damage on a fail,
half on a success.
